name: St. Regis Maldives Vommuli Resort
insider_take: This isn't just another overwater villa resort – it's where luxury meets marine conservation in the heart of the Indian Ocean's most pristine atoll.
whats_special: The St. Regis Maldives sits on Vommuli Island in the Dhaalu Atoll, home to one of the world's largest populations of whale sharks and manta rays. The resort features the Maldives' largest overwater spa and the first string quartet to perform regularly in the archipelago. Each villa comes with a dedicated Thakuru (island host) providing legendary St. Regis butler service.
pro_tip: Book the Whale Shark Research Excursion between May and December – Dhaalu Atoll offers some of the most reliable whale shark encounters in the Maldives, and proceeds support local marine conservation efforts.
dont_miss: The evening ritual at Decanter, where the resort's sommelier conducts wine tastings featuring rare vintages while dolphins often play in the lagoon below. Also experience the traditional Maldivian cooking class using ingredients from the resort's hydroponic garden – one of the few sustainable farming initiatives in the coral islands.
pros: Luxury overwater and beach villas with private pools and direct lagoon access
World-class spa and wellness facilities with signature St. Regis butler service
Multiple award-winning dining venues featuring international and Maldivian cuisine
Comprehensive water sports center and world-class diving sites nearby
cons: Remote island location requires seaplane transfer
